[spoiler=[b]Tallislandic Eclipse[/b]]

The capture of the Office of the Navy, despite how much life it cost and the little equipment seized, proved to be a great disaster to the Principalist government, who lost countless records, classified documents, etc stored in the facility as well as the flagship carrier of the Tallislandic fleet. Even worse, following the seizure the head of the Tallislandic navy Admiral Augustus Sikorski broke out of Radicalist captivity and escaped to the island of Tylerek, from where he declared himself Regent of the Kingdom of Szbulba and Emperor of the White Sea.

Despite his apparent madness, Sikorski garnered much support among those in the Navy who were already unconvinced of Principalist rule, and even more amongst seamen and sailors who were of Szbulban and Rechite heritage. Donning their own flag resembling that of the Pre-1800 subjugation of Szbulba by Tallisland, Sikorski has claimed loyalty not to the Principalists or Anti-Principalists, but to himself alone.

Given the Szbulban's proud history of pilfering and raiding the straits of the White Sea, some Tallislandics (especially those in the cabinet of the Holy President) have expressed that these heretics will bring about a return of piracy in the White Sea under their fake kingdom. 

Sikorski, from a villa on Tylerek, would begin the command of his fleet, of his people. Naval leadership of Tallisland followed Sikorski to Tylerek, including 3 submarines, 9 mine warfare vessels, 11 cruisers, 7 frigates, 6 destroyers, 20 corvettes, and 3 patrol boats. Now calling himself Emperor Augustus the Excellent of the White Sea, he renamed each vessel to have Szbulban names, and forced them to use the Szbulban naval banners.

Augustus now wielded a total of 56 vessels, which he intended to use as a means to push both the EDU and THEP out of his country's sovereign seas. Emperor Augustus would attempt to contact the fleet of the Neue Republik, requesting that they retreat their soldiers from the White Sea Islands and leave Tallislandic-now Szbulban seas. 

Being fair to all sides involved, the Kingdom of Szbulba too demanded the AWN withdraw from their sovereign territory and leave Szbulban waters, radioing to THEP forces to demand the same.

Stennes dumped the rest of the magazine into the corpse, saving the final round to shoot the body-double. Kjersti tossed the gun onto the double's corpse, and drove away. 

Watt's Loyalists officially split the next day, when he learned that the double had been killed. Claiming leadership of the Commune of Tallisland, he gained much support from the rural parts of Rechia, and those more skeptical of some of the more racialist elements of Stennes rebellion. With many socialist revolutions occuring worldwide, he too banked on those that supported those rebellions coming to his aid. 

At first, many were reluctant to fight against those who had protested and even occasionally fought alongside them, many first demanding the enemy loyalists run away, beating, apprehending, or even hesitantly killing those that refused. To their reluctance, Watts emphasized that these traitors must be killed for true freedom to be brought to Tallisland.

The civil war progressed immensely, with the Anti-Principalists gaining much ground, even despite being severed from the AWN support in the south. Their attempts to cross the Szbulban Sea was almost completely halted by the strong Republik defense, killing thousands in their repetitive naval assaults.

By the time the legislative/judicial capital of Kranowo nad Bridgenay fell, opposition leader Finley Gallagher had finally gathered enough supporters to begin a vote of no confidence in Holy President Clifford Prisk's ability to protect and maintain the Holy Republic. His reign was coming to a close, no doubt, and it wouldn't be long before he would have to face his demons and suffer for his crimes.

Holy President Clifford Prisk and his closest followers had received information from meteorologists that a gargantuan earthquake was inbound to Tallisland by December, and purposefully withheld the information from those that did not support him. He still had support in Tel Karmiw, or if he didn't, he could hide out there.

President Prisk, Vice President Krzywicki, Prime Minister Piekarz, and the rest of the Presidential Cabinet all boarded a private jet bound to Tel Karmiw, telling not a soul of their plans or of the incoming earthquake. The elite of Tallisland merely up and disappeared.

Fighter aircraft requisitioned by the Free Republic of Tallisland quickly sortied to respond to the aircraft, catching it less than a hundred miles from the Sanguivallis border-only a few miles away from freedom. When the jet refused to identity itself or it's passengers, the Free Republic fighters engaged, firing two missiles into the engines.

When Free Republic soldiers arrived via truck to the crash, they quickly learned of the nature of the aircraft, and executed each of the Presidential Guard that survived one by one, until the President and his followers were defenseless. Many of the rebels took turns posing in photographs with the members of government, before executing them as well.

The crash, and the corpses that littered it, were simply left there and the Free Republic continued it's offensive toward Osliburne.

With the President and his Loyalists officially dead now, Finley Gallagher claimed the title of President, as did the legal successor High War-Priest Wojciech Saebaldr. By December 9th, there were five independent factions now fighting for control of Tallisland.

And then the earthquake hit.

A category 7.7. One of the largest in Elseyran history, and doubtlessly the largest in Tallislandic history. It ravaged the already freezing west of the nation, and the severed heat and electric lines cost the lives of hundreds at least. The chaos spurred further instability, culminating in the death of rebel-leader and icon Kjersti Stennes on the 11th.

Patriarch Błoński had refused to evacuate the nation alongside the man that had appointed him to be his ally, Clifford Prisk. Błoński believed that Prisk's sins were finally catching up to him, and that his abandonment of the faithful in Tallisland was an action he could no longer support. As such, he and the Church remained in Evraibal through the earthquake. 

On December 12, Błoński declared himself High Patriarch of the Lusandric Faith, a title unused since the grand prophet Luzandrich spread the gospel to what is now Tallisland. He was using a pre-Republic title to declare the Republic void, that since nobody could agree on who the President was that he held the power to seize both positions.

High Patriarch Błoński now ordered all Lusandric faithfuls in Tallisland to return to Evraibal, both to help and be helped in the wake of the earthquake. 

With the rebellion now in shambles and split among hopefuls, radicals, visionaries and satanists, true anarchy had befell Tallisland. Even those that weren't aggressive before turned into murderous bandits after the earthquake, but they knew that the oppressive Lusandrics couldn't be allowed to strengthen their position.

A group of rebels subscribing to an ethno-nationalist subsection of Young Tallisland prepared thousands of samples of mixed mustard gas and VX, preparing to unleash it on east Tallisland to decimate any remaining government forces, and force the Lusandrics to suffer an equal fate as they had suffered from the earthquake.

Christmas Eve is when the attack began, designed to target the weaker children and gathered crowds of individuals that would celebrate for the Birth of Christ. Gas bombs were detonated in Nowy Białton and Bramptonik, intended to spread downwind and along the flat plains of east Tallisland. Thousands died before the Church was able to begin distribution of masks, disinfectants, and medical supplies to civilians.

Finally, High Patriarch Błoński ordered for the hasty construction of a wall to protect the faithful around Evraibal, and to keep out bandits and warlords that now ran rampant in the anarchy of Tallisland. 

As for the regent of the Szbulbans, Emperor of the White Sea, Admiral Augustus Sikorski, he would be killed by overexposure to VX, dying alongside many Lusandric Faithfuls who had lost their lives distributing medicines and antidotes to civilians.

Tallisland had fallen, it's Church had seized a portion of the country and walled off the rest. A developed nation reduced to this was pitiful on the Elseyran continent. Those that lived through the civil war chose a new lifestyle: living in the hellhole that was former Tallisland, devoting themselves to a Lusandric lifestyle in the Church territory, or leaving the country entirely.

The Szbulban fleet however didn't truly fit into any of these categories, but they found soon of a group of individuals taking over islands in Kianzhou that held similar beliefs to that of their once-great Szbulba. So Sikorski's orphaned fleet wandered themselves across the Nestor Sea, soon enough finding allies in a people named the Fjordorans, agreeing to a confederacy with the people alongside their 56 ships.

Tel Karmiw remained with the church, though the mass chaos in Tallisland sparked a sense of resistance in the people there too. Mass Pan-Shamatist protests began across the nation, and High Patriarch Błoński was already in too poor of a position to begin a long-range conflict against the Karmiwan people. Thus, he invited a representative from nearby [nation=long+noflag]Tan Srpka[/nation] to transfer the island to the more Pan-Shamatist-friendly regime of Alaqar. 

[/Spoiler]

[b]January 10-13, 2027: The 2nd Peoples Congress: On Colonialism and the Rate of Federalism, And the Maarav state[/b]

Three days had passed since the start of the congress, most disagreements had been put down with concessions, the monarchic order would be absorbed not as new leaders but as members of the new government, bureaucrats, etc. Their properties would become state owned and host cultural events and serve as the new federal states cultural centers. 

However, the topic of Thývens shamatine territory was soon brought up on January 10th as the question over the legacy of the territory arose. Taken from a nomadic jewish group known as the HaMaarav, and turned into a glorified Shamatine military training, staging, and major united forces base, it currently was serving as the staging ground for the withdrawal from Izmyr further east. 

It was generally believed that holding the territory directly had been a drain on military resources and the military budget, with almost 30% of the budget going towards maintaining troops and the base there, as well as construction and other fees associated with holding a base on a foreign continent. Not to mention, the disruptions of 25-26 had caused the military establishment in the region to lose its firm grip on the nomadic peoples there.

UREV invites all foreign dignitaries and representatives of corporations in the opening ceremony of the tower, expected to happen in the coming weeks. Foreign entities may also bid for space in the tower and establish a presence in the city of the future.[/spoiler]
